title: Quake Nations Cup 2008

[[image:quake_nations_cup_logo.jpg]] [http://www.quake.cz/ Czech Quake] is trying to organise biggest and best action by connecting all Quake scenes across and try to set up cooperation between all Quake scenes. == Information == * Games: QuakeWorld TDM, Quake 2 TDM, Quake 3 TDM, Quake 4 TDM * Last day to sign up is 13th January 2008. * First rounds of games will start on 14th January 2008. * Official website: [http://www.quake.cz/NationsCup/ Quake Nations Cup] * Idea, organization: Hawrix * QW Admin: [[JohnNy_cz]] and [[Zappater]] ** [http://www.quake.cz/?q4=news&iD=1166 QuakeWorld section] == Signed Nations (QW) == [[image:flag_cz.gif]] '''[[Czech Republic]]''' - [[JohnNy_cz]], [[Flamer]], [[itmik]], [[shpeq]], [[jebak]], [[Fr4g]], [[moris]], [[cuky]]
